stepBody:
Fill in the blanks to add the two following columns to skate\_record:
- number\_of\_W: The number of words where an uppercase W is surrounded by $$1$$ or more adjacent uppercase letters on each side (e.g., UWU, OWNed, SHOWDOWN) in comments.
- mean\_Q: The average of two critics' ratings for each row.
You are not allowed to use functions from the library re in this subpart (3(c)).
skate\_record["number\_of\_W"] $$=$$ (
\_\_\_\_i\_\_\_\_.findall(\_\_\_\_ii\_\_\_\_)
.\_\_\_\_iii\_\_\_\_()
)
\_\_\_\_iv\_\_\_\_ $$=$$ (\_\_\_\_v\_\_\_\_) / $$2$$
